verdict.rationale: GrowthBook is a feature-flag and experimentation platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. Its docs describe an official MCP server that connects AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude, loads GrowthBook Agent Skills, and makes authenticated calls to the GrowthBook REST API; a probe confirms the documentation page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that an agent actually connected via the MCP server, and detailed documentation of the tool list or scope.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude to GrowthBook using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
The official GrowthBook MCP server is a thin bridge: it loads GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails) and makes authenticated calls to the GrowthBook REST API.
